essence: Dependence in the self-created realm is not imposed from outside but is manifested by the Lord himself.
The sole defining mark of dependence and autonomy is that the autonomous Lord freely fashions dependence.
Treating the limiter as itself limited threatens to collapse the distinction between limiter and limited.
Because the external object lacks self-luminosity, its apprehension cannot be grounded in it alone.
Knowledge cannot ground manifestation if it is itself unmanifest and not self-luminous.
